claims.label: PROVED_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW
claims.exact_statement: For every n and every Boolean b on {0,1}^n with b(0)=1, let b' flip only the origin, delta=2^(-n), Psi(a,e)=phi(a^2)+phi(e)-phi(a^2+e), and L_n(b)=sum_S Psi(bhat(S)-delta,delta^2). For physical coordinate i, the data-before-selector order-swap credit Gamma_i=L_n(b)-L_(n-1)(b restricted to x_i=0)/2 equals sum_{T not containing i}[Psi(x_T,delta^2)+Psi(y_T,delta^2)-Psi(x_T+y_T,4delta^2)/2], where x_T=bhat(T)-delta and y_T=bhat(T union {i})-delta. This total need not be nonnegative. For q_n(0)=1 and q_n(x)=-1 otherwise, Gamma_i<0 for every n>=3 and every i, with Gamma_i=delta^2(-2n+6-log2(e))+O(delta^3). For the unequal tensor q_4 tensor q_5, all nine physical coordinates have negative credit; rigorous intervals give Gamma<-0.00022 in the q_4 factor and Gamma<-0.00026 in the q_5 factor.

dependencies.role: positive mechanism whose universal extension is delimited

refutes: Every Boolean one-point-defect selector pair has a physical data coordinate with nonnegative first data/selector order-swap credit.
The bent data-prefix nonnegative-credit proof extends at unchanged hypotheses to arbitrary unequal prime factors.
does_not_refute: existence of a different global stopping-tree potential
